\[
W = \begin{bmatrix}
  52 & 61 & 58 \\
  49 & 0 & 63 \\
  55 & 66 & 60
\end{bmatrix}
\]

The center is a pepper pixel. With Q = 1.5, each value is weighted by its own power 1.5, and the pepper pixel gets weight 0. The output is **58.73**, close to the 8 ordinary values. With Q = -1.5, the same window gives 0, because the 0 dominates.
